 Home › US News US News Miss Universe Delegates Arrive in Puerto Rico for 75th Anniversary
 By T. Vishnudatta Jayaraman 
 November 9, 2026 · 2 minutes read
 Listen 1× 
 Courtesy: Miss Universe Organization 
 Delegates competing in Miss Universe 2026 have begun arriving in Puerto Rico for the pageant’s 75th anniversary, with 121 representatives scheduled to participate in activities leading up to the November 24 final, according to a statement from the Miss Universe Organization.
 The organization said international fans have been traveling to the island since early November, sharing photos and videos of their visits and the delegates’ arrivals. Supporters in participating countries also held send-off celebrations, while fans in Puerto Rico organized welcomes featuring cultural performances and other festivities, the statement noted.
 The arrivals have coincided with increased online discussion about the pageant, according to a social media and digital news analysis cited in the statement.

 PHOTOS: Miss Universe Organization 
 The analysis, covering English- and Spanish-language content from October 31 through November 7, recorded more than 6,100 mentions related to Miss Universe 2026 in Puerto Rico, twice the volume recorded during the previous seven days.
 Advertisement
 Any shape 
 Using automated tools to classify sentiment and emotions, the analysis found that positive mentions outnumbered negative ones by three to one, with joy identified as the most prevalent emotion. The statement attributed much of the discussion to delegates’ arrivals, supporters’ national pride and anticipation of the competitions.
 “One of the most special things about Miss Universe is seeing how each country comes together to support its representative. We’re thrilled by the warm welcome the delegates are receiving in Puerto Rico and the excitement we’re already seeing, even before the competition begins,” said Ronald Day, CEO of the Miss Universe Organization.
 The official Miss Universe gathering began November 8. During their stay, the delegates will take part in cultural, tourism, social and official activities across Puerto Rico, along with rehearsals and preparations for three nights of competition, according to the statement.
 PHOTOS: Miss Universe Organization 
 The representatives are scheduled to stay at the Wyndham Grand Rio Mar Rainforest, Beach & Golf Resort in Río Grande from November 8 through 15. They will then move to the San Juan Marriott Resort & Stellaris Casino in Condado, where they will remain through November 25.
 Public events include a welcome parade at Aguadilla Bay on November 11 and the Meet and Greet the Miss Universe Delegates event at Vivo Beach Club on November 18.
 Reigning Miss Universe Fátima Bosch is also scheduled to meet fans on November 12 at The Miss Universe Experience at Plaza Las Américas, the organization said.
 The anniversary program will conclude with three competitions at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot in San Juan. The National Costume Competition is scheduled for November 21, followed by the Preliminary Competition on November 22 and the final and crowning ceremony on November 24.
 Fans can vote for their preferred delegates through the organization’s official platform at missuniverseorg.com/vote. According to the statement, the contestant receiving the most public votes will earn a place among the Top 30 semifinalists.
